decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project or key milestone, no replies to three Wrenfield emails (22f261ca, 2b5a4df1, 79eb7da8) and zero tickets — low engagement. One invite sent (slack:87b1811d) is a mild positive signal, but 8 days left with no activity suggests unaided activation is unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Granite Media's first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

I saw you've already invited a teammate to Wrenfield — nice start. The next step that usually makes everything click is creating a first project, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and if it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and go through that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
